label: ICD-10
notes: NEEDS CONTEXT, do not map. Ruled 2026-09-30 (Ryan, vocabulary_formats-yq4): a bare ICD-10 label is UNDECIDED and is resolved paper by paper - a reader returns it as an undecided ICD-10 and the calling program picks one of candidates from the paper's own evidence. It mapped to ICD10 (WHO) until then. WHO ICD-10 is a different vocabulary from ICD10CM with disjoint concept_ids, and the litmine pilot found papers labelling WHO codes as ICD-10-CM and vice versa (E14.3, H36.0, X45 in SIDIAP/HES studies), so no single mapping is right for every paper. Evidence: every candidate verified present in ohdsi_vocabs.vocabulary in the vocabulation build (2026-09-17; just test re-checks it). Excluded by the same ruling: the OI supplementals ICD10CM_HEAD, ICD10CM_ALPHA_INDEX and ICD10CM_EINDEX, and ICDO3 / ICD03_*. The concept table remains the backstop that catches a mislabelled code.
